name: Alex Muster
headline: Cloud & Enterprise Architect · Azure · Banking
claim: Well-governed cloud platforms for banking, designed together with the teams who build and run them.
profile: Cloud and enterprise architect with an MSc in Business Information Technology (Beispiel-Hochschule) and over six years in IT consulting and enterprise architecture. At Beispiel Kantonalbank I co-developed the cloud strategy and sourcing model, advised the cloud value stream on solutions from the Azure service catalogue and designed the architecture for operational resilience, cloud backup and infrastructure lifecycle management. At Globex Consulting I designed Azure target architectures and cloud security services and took part in a global migration of 1,000+ servers across 50+ countries to Azure. Native German speaker, fluent in English.

letter.subject: Application: Senior Cloud Architect 80–100% (job reference BB-7710)
attention: A card business needs a cloud platform that is fast for product teams and stays under firm control. At Beispiel Kantonalbank I worked on both sides of this balance: architecture standards and governance rules agreed with the DevOps teams, and architecture for operational resilience and cloud backup. I would like to bring this experience to your new Cloud Center of Excellence.
interest: What draws me to the role is the chance to build a cloud foundation from the start: a new team, a hybrid platform blueprint in which network, identity and security are designed in from day one, and a governance framework shaped together with security specialists and engineers.

points: Azure architecture in production: at Globex Consulting I designed Azure target architectures and cloud security services (WAF, load balancer), connected SIEM and monitoring tools globally and planned the move from Active Directory to Entra ID. I also took part in a global migration of more than 1,000 servers to Azure.

Platform governance in a bank: at Beispiel Kantonalbank I advised the cloud value stream on solutions from the Azure service catalogue, reviewed projects against architecture standards and analysed security components to assess solution architectures.

Landing zones and integration: at initech I coordinated stakeholders and developers on a health insurer's cloud integration strategy based on an Azure landing zone, and designed the integration of an on-prem Oracle database into Dynamics 365, incl. a proof of concept.
Hands-on depth: Kubernetes and Docker at Helix and initech, Helix Cloud Private set up on-premise from virtual machines to containers, and the Azure Solutions Architect certification (AZ-305).

desire: I work in a structured, reliable way and explain trade-offs clearly to engineers and decision makers.
action: I would welcome a conversation about how I can help shape your platform blueprint and cloud governance framework.
